implementation: online measured-depth map and EGO-Swarm ROS2, no course model or target list
launch_envelope_assumption: Operator must verify a local 1 m by 1 m takeoff box up to 1.05 m above the resting body. This limited operating precondition is labeled separately from measured free voxels; no other free space is invented.
camera_mount_note: Same stereo/IMU, physical rigid pitch 15 and roll 0 degrees, body-fixed downward ToF. No digital image rotation, new sensor, texture or ideal depth; hardware mount uncalibrated.
return_assumption: Static environment only: return through the already observed map may translate backward while keeping the previously tracked camera heading. A forward-only camera cannot detect newly introduced rear obstacles; this is not a dynamic-obstacle or hardware flight acceptance.
observation_latency_note: Bounded 350 ms measured-depth pipeline budget; measured-velocity stopping checks include this full latency. Short stale periods latch a brake point and require measured-state replanning after settling.
stereo_matching_note: CPU measured-stereo development proxy: retain native 800p imagery for VIO, match reduced 400p pairs with scaled focal length and LR pixel tolerance, nearest-resample measurements/invalid pixels to the native ray grid. Target OAK firmware output still requires its actual calibration and confidence validation.
inferred_geometry_note: Optional conditional geometric free-only support has separate 600 ms maximum age. Its full age enters stopping-distance checks; direct measured-map freshness remains 350 ms. Inference cannot refresh the raw stream.
survey_note: A 0.70m relative survey keeps the camera near the upper envelope of the 0.55m cruise body while retaining nearby ground features with the proposed 15-degree rigid mount. This uses robot geometry, not course dimensions.
yaw_request_note: Native-FCU yaw request is slew limited at 20 deg/s and kept within 10 deg of actual estimated heading, including localization recovery; not a field turn sequence or a physical-rate guarantee.
